reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.text: You need to pay first before you use.

reviews.title: Bad app!
reviews.text: It won’t let you log into the app without upgrading to a pro account. The online version works ok. But you can’t change any of your settings online, you have to use the app. Why offer a free account if you can’t use it? Also I can’t submit a ticket to get customer support for this. It just stays on the submit screen. I want to love it but just can’t. The idea is great. But I feel like there is no way to know if the paid version is any better in the details that matter. When the free version is so limited, it doesn’t inspire be to pay $30 for a “pro” version, a month hoping it will be better.

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: After you sign up they ask you to subscribe and no mention of that at the beginning

reviews.title: Bait and Switch
reviews.text:
Like most apps, it talks about great promises, but asked for a review before I even started using it and didn't even let me use the software without First signing up for a subscription.

If a product is good, I should be able to use it and not be able to go without it and I'd be happy to pay, but the fact that they need me to subscribe before even trying it out is a huge red flag.

reviews.title: Pushy
reviews.text: Before I had even tried the app they were forcing me to write a review. Their sales techniques created an awful experience.

reviews.title: App changes
reviews.text: Completely ruined how I find the most recent invoices and estimates. Now I have to write down what invoices and estimates I make to make sure I search them when I want to go back to them. Which makes this app pointless now if I have to write it down. Will be unsubscribing 100%

reviews.title: Just no
reviews.text: It just wants your phone number like Google so it can get spammed with request for you to buy ad space

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Could not even check out the estimate prices without signing up for $30 per month, the app will not let you do anything until you sign up for the pro option.

reviews.title: Underbid
reviews.text: Wanted to see how far off I was on furnace estimates. HOLY SMOKES it underbid jobs about $500 on furnace installs and I know I’m too cheap to begin with. 29.99 a month is crazy.

reviews.title: Thirsty and pointless much?
reviews.text: Why would you even BOTHER asking me for a review before I’ve even finished with the SETUP process on your app? How is that valuable feedback at all?? Well, there’s far too much pressing “Next” through screens that promise this app can do magic, some sample invoices that show some vastly-incorrect arithmetic, and then you’ve asked for my name, and a review and rating. So far, so….. meh? I guess?

reviews.title: Unauthorized subscription renewal
reviews.text: Wanted to try the app since I have another one to see if it was better but didn’t work for me and canceled the subscription but yet I was charged anyways, hate when companies do that where you cancel and they still charge you hoping you won’t notice until months later I reported the unauthorized charge to my card hopefully I get I refund if I ever switch from the app I’m currently using I’m definitely not coming back to use this one.

reviews.title: Don’t bother downloading
reviews.text: I kept seeing adds for this about automatically building estimates with just a picture after trying again and again uploading the picture does nothing all the app does is make line items to put in that you manually click I had no help doing anything not impressed at all

reviews.title: Not useful
reviews.text: Like most “super helpful” AI driven apps or services it makes mistake after mistake and you spend more time prompting/editing it than it would to type or use text to speech. If you have a simple template and have spent more than one day in construction, you can skip this. “Live prices” but it only pulled 2 items from a single verified source (Home Depot). Charging customers for a pole to paint with, and other items that are staples that you would reuse. Would I charge every customer for a hammer? I’ll save you the suspense - the subscription is 30$ a month. This is great for people that have never worked in the industry - like those franchise handymen that just send other people out to do jobs. If you need to use AI to multiply your hourly rate X amount of hours and take 5 minutes to make 30 mistakes than this is the app for you.
